requirements.spacing: Kirigami.Units and font metrics; observed pixels are not literal constraints
requirements.palette: Kirigami.Theme roles; only background-role line-fill shades may differ from HTML role-text mixing
requirements.aligned_boundary: List header and file toolbar hairlines align; HTML list height 38 versus file header 40 is a reference defect, not permission to misalign
requirements.window_720: Each text pane at least eight measured rows; controls reachable directly, by page scroll, or native overflow
requirements.window_800: Supplemental captures; file rows must remain single line
requirements.window_960: Owner waiver of strict control-fit and pane-height; scrolling/first-undecided visibility remain required
requirements.comparison: No masks, thresholds, replacement screenshots or global similarity score; all changed pixels reported

row_pitch.decision: Font line spacing plus smallSpacing governs; keep row-height/scroll/budget synchronized; literal 20 is not a repair.

header_inset.decision: largeSpacing governs; native largeSpacing is 8. Do not hardcode 12.

sidebar_width.decision: 14 * native gridUnit 18 = 252; resizable. Do not hardcode 262.

file_toolbar_height.decision: Native ActionToolBar row height governs; list header boundary must align.

footer_height.decision: One actual smallFont line plus theme spacing and native frame/separator allowances; inspect missing/excess padding rather than force 28.
